# Jiangshan schematic data notices

Three selected schematic shapes from https://github.com/haitaowu12/jiangshan-map, commit `fcd6484d06d3c581241fc24adbab288cf3a4a2ea`, `js/atlas_snapshots.js`. Original author: DeanChensj, 2026.

The source README declares GPL-3.0 and describes these outlines as schematic approximations. Its root LICENSE is MIT. Both notices are retained: the full GPL-3.0 text is supplied as `territories.LICENSE`; the MIT notice follows below. This is not a claim that each upstream third-party reference is MIT licensed. The source cites CHGIS, Hartwell, Tan Qixiang and historical-basemaps, but does not identify a derivation source for each outline. No CHGIS dataset was downloaded or redistributed in this supplement. Per-outline provenance remains unresolved and should be documented in future source contributions.

Modifications: selected three main-polity outlines; translated display names; attached exact source phase intervals and scholarly context; normalized GeoJSON and D3 winding. No frontier redrawing.
